import numpy as np, base64, json, subprocess, sys

def make_square(freq=440, dur=0.2, sr=44100):
    n = int(sr*dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    # square wave: sign(sin)
    wave = np.sign(np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t))
    # Smooth a bit? Keep sharp
    # Apply simple decay
    decay = np.linspace(1, 0.3, n)
    wave *= decay
    return (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)

def make_saw(freq=110, dur=0.3, sr=44100):
    n = int(sr*dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    # sawtooth
    wave = 2*(t*freq - np.floor(0.5 + t*freq))
    decay = np.linspace(1, 0.4, n)
    wave *= decay
    return (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)

def make_sine(freq=880, dur=0.15, sr=44100):
    n = int(sr*dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    wave = np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t)
    decay = np.exp(-3*t/dur)
    wave *= decay
    return (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)

    wave = np.random.uniform(-1, 1, n)

    return (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)
